description: This file is a Java interface for data access operations related to ProductAttribute entities in an e-commerce system, defining methods for querying product attributes by various criteria.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending generic DAO for ProductAttribute entities, providing methods to retrieve product attributes based on option ID, value ID, product, and attribute IDs.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieve a list of ProductAttribute objects filtered by a specific merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieve a list of ProductAttribute objects filtered by merchant store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieve product attributes associated with a specific product, merchant store, and language.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieve product attributes matching a list of attribute IDs within a specific merchant store.
